meta.title: Marble Mountains with Kids - 156 Steps! | Travel in Da Nang, Vietnam
meta.description:
Come with us as we take our 3 and 7 year old up Marble Mountain in Da Nang, Vietnam.

Image credits: 
https://centralvietnamguide.com/am-phu-cave/
https://www.pipeaway.com/am-phu-cave-marble-mountain-hell-cave-vietnam/

If you love this video, please like it and SUBSCRIBE to our channel - it would mean the world to us!

CHAPTERS:
00:00 - Intro
01:03 - Arriving At Marble Mountains
02:03 - The Climb Up
03:50 - Our First Cave
06:12 - Our Mistake
06:54 - Review Of Climb With Kids
07:32 - The Highest Peak
08:43 - Huyen Khong Cave

comments.author: @arwenmegan
comments.text: I plan to visit the Marble Mountains in January, and I want to know how much time I should allocate for my visit. Also, what time of the day would you recommend for my visit? Thank you in advance

comments.author: @worldofourmaking
comments.text: We went at about 8am in the morning and spent about 2 hours there. This felt like a good amount of time and wasn't too busy either.
